bug_semantics: In rpc_read_from_socket READ_IOVEC, after a zero-copy READ payload is recv()d into the application iovec, the code does `rpc->pdu->read_count -= rpc->pdu_size` then unconditionally `rpc->rm_xid[0] -= rpc->pdu_size`. rm_xid[0] is the remaining ONC-RPC record-marker length (uint32). pdu_size for READ_IOVEC is set to pdu->read_count (the expected remaining read payload). A crafted NFS server can make the expected payload larger than the remaining record-marker length; the unsigned subtract underflows rm_xid[0], so later READ_PADDING/recv length is huge. Fix 935b8db returns -1 when rm_xid[0] < pdu_size before subtracting.
flaw_origin: 5e8f7ce273308eb77f94248f4501e574a703c1a5 (2024-02-11, "Add (almost) Zero-Copy for READ3.") first added READ_IOVEC and wrote `rpc->rm_xid[0] -= pdu_size` with no remaining-length check. Parent cc04864854d7ad9ef8daf31e2b31d79d4f5fe60e has lib/socket.c but no READ_IOVEC and no rm_xid[0] -= pdu_size. 84ebfa53 only renamed static pdu_size to rpc->pdu_size; later socket edits until 935b8db did not add the underflow guard.

Advisory names xid integer underflow in READ_IOVEC in rpc_read_from_socket in lib/socket.c through 6.0.2 before 935b8db. git show 935b8db -- lib/socket.c inserts `if (rpc->rm_xid[0] < rpc->pdu_size) return -1;` before `rpc->rm_xid[0] -= rpc->pdu_size`. libnfs-6.0.2 still has the unguarded subtract; the fix is in libnfs-7.0.0/7.0.1. git log -S READ_IOVEC -- lib/socket.c first-write is 5e8f7ce; git cat-file -e cc048648:lib/socket.c succeeds; grep of parent for READ_IOVEC / rm_xid[0] -= pdu_size is empty. git cat-file -p 5e8f7ce and git log -1 --format="%an %ae %cn %ce" 5e8f7ce show only Ronnie Sahlberg; marker grep on that object is empty. Single parent, not a merge/squash.
reasoning: Vulnerability first: READ_IOVEC subtracts pdu_size from unsigned rm_xid[0] without checking that the remaining record-marker length is at least the expected iovec payload, so a crafted NFS reply underflows the remaining PDU size. That state and unguarded subtract were born with zero-copy READ3 in 5e8f7ce; the parent tree has socket.c but lacks those lines, so this is the smallest public first-write. Moving pdu_size onto rpc_context is a rename, not the origin. Fix 935b8db is the first content change that rejects rm_xid[0] < pdu_size and matches the advisory.
